hints.title: Longest Non-Decreasing Prefix Sequence
hints.text: At each position i, we need the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence ending at index i.

hints.title: Patience Sorting Tails Array
hints.text: Maintain an array tails where tails[k] stores the minimum ending value of an obstacle course of length k + 1.

hints.title: Binary Search for Rightmost Valid Insertion
hints.text: Use binary search (bisect_right) to find the insertion index of obstacles[i] in non-decreasing tails.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Patience sorting with binary search tracking longest non-decreasing sequence.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Classic O(N^2) dynamic programming times out for N = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic tails array enables logarithmic insertion lookup per obstacle.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize standard patience sorting / bisect_right for non-decreasing sequences.
